title: (performance, D3D12) The present pass recreates its shader views every frame, and the post-process and bloom helpers build every descriptor table fres
note: Design (read 11-18): GameBloom::table and PostProcessor::draw call CreateShaderResourceView and CreateUnorderedAccessView for every slot of every pass into the frame's ring (60 a frame with NORMAL bloom). Each target gets its views once, in a CPU-only staging heap, when ensure_target makes it (null views made once at initialize); a pass's table is CopyDescriptorsSimple of those handles into the ring. The ring keeps its fencing, so no table outlives what it names, and a remade target only rewrites its own staging views. Vulkan and Metal bind images per pass already without a view creation (checked when built). Proof: the gate's pictures the same on D3D12 and a CPU timing of present() and game_bloom() before and after (timeline, idle PC). Built 11-18 (85eeb6d67): DescriptorRing::write_view makes each view once in a CPU-only heap keyed by its resource and every field of its description, and copies it (CopyDescriptorsSimple); views not written for frames_in_flight+1 frames are dropped. Every per-frame view call of the post chain, bloom, ambient occlusion, the scene camera, the mod post pass and the renderer goes through it. Test: post_process_tests view_cache_on_warp (made once, a new format is a new view, null and UAV views, unread union bytes, the reference held, the drop, growth).
